Notre technologie innovante permet de traiter des cas d’usage qui sont à ce jour hors de portée des plus puissants des supercalculateurs ; ces cas peuvent concerner des défis industriels applicatifs aussi bien que les besoins des sciences fondamentales. Au-delà de la puissance de calcul exceptionnelle qu’ils apportent, les QPUs sont d’une très grande efficacité énergétique et contribueront à réduire fortement l’empreinte carbone de l’industrie du calcul intensif. A propos d'Aeponyx Basée à Montréal, Aeponyx (www.aeponyx.com) est un leader dans le développement de dispositifs de photonique intégrés en nitrure de silicium. Grâce à sa technologie brevetée qui allie les systèmes micro électromécaniques (MEMS) et la photonique sur silicium, nous concevons et fabriquons des circuits de photonique intégrée (PIC) destinés aux applications de télécommunications, aux centres de données et aux technologies quantiques. Aeponyx est une filiale canadienne de Pasqal SAS (https://www.pasqal.com/fr/), pionnier mondial des ordinateurs quantiques à atomes neutres. Le Poste Nous recherchons une personne expérimentée pour prendre en charge notre environnement TI multisite. La personne titulaire du poste agira comme référence technique pour la cybersécurité, les environnements de calcul, la virtualisation, le stockage et la gestion du parc informatique. Vous devez collaborer étroitement avec les différentes équipes afin de fournir des services TI sécurisés, performants et adaptés aux contraintes d'une entreprise de haute technologie. Le poste est principalement basé à Montréal, au CEIM. Compétences et responsabilités Le candidat sera responsable de la gestion du parc informatique, des logiciels, de la Cybersécurité ainsi que de la gestion, protection et reprise des données Un jugement technique, une bonne autonomie et une approche structurée en résolution de problèmes sont nécessaires. Rigueur documentaire, sens de l'organisation et bon communicateur. Profil recherché Minimum de 5 années d'expérience pertinente en administration de systèmes et d'infrastructures, dont une expérience démontrée dans un environnement multisite ou hybride. Maîtrise de Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, ADSync ou Microsoft Entra Connect, Microsoft Intune et Windows Autopilot. Expérience pratique de l'intégration de systèmes Linux dans un domaine Windows Server et de l'administration d'environnements Linux en production. Expérience en virtualisation de serveurs, en stockage résilient, en sauvegarde et en reprise après sinistre Formation: Diplôme universitaire ou collégial en informatique, génie informatique, cybersécurité ou domaine connexe, ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience. Atouts: Bonne maîtrise des réseaux IP, VLAN, VPN, pare-feu, QoS et gestion du trafic. (Connaissances et expériences) Expérience avec Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) ou une plateforme de stockage comparable. (Connaissances et expériences) Langue: L’employé doit être capable de communiquer efficacement en français, à l'oral et à l'écrit. La connaissance de l’anglais est un atout pour la collaboration avec d’autres scientifiques détenant une expertise spécifique, ainsi qu’avec les partenaires à l’extérieur du pays. Pasqal designs and develops Quantum Processing Units and dedicated software tools. These innovative processors address applications which are out of the reach of the most powerful existing supercomputers, encompassing real-world challenges as well as fundamental science. As they are very low energy intensive, they will significantly contribute to reduce the carbon footprint of the computing industry. With partnerships with key users in the fields of energy, IT, finance, drug and chemical design, automotive PASQAL is a true leader in the Neutral Atom Quantum computing space. About Aeponyx Based in Montreal, Aeponyx (www.aeponyx.com) is a leader in the development of integrated photonic devices in silicon nitride. Thanks to its patented technology combining micro‑electromechanical systems (MEMS) with silicon photonics, we design and manufacture integrated photonic circuits (PICs) for telecommunications, data centers, and quantum technology applications. Aeponyx is a Canadian subsidiary of Pasqal SAS (https://www.pasqal.com/fr/), a global pioneer in neutral‑atom quantum computers. The position We are looking for an experienced professional to manage our multi-site IT environment. The successful candidate will act as the technical reference for cybersecurity, computing environments, virtualization, storage, and IT asset management. You will work closely with various teams to provide secure, high-performing IT services tailored to the constraints of a high-tech company. The position is primarily based in Montreal, at the CEIM. Skills And Responsibilities The candidate will be responsible for managing IT assets, software, cybersecurity, as well as data management, protection, and disaster recovery. Technical judgment, strong autonomy, and a structured approach to problem-solving are required. Strong documentation skills, a sense of organization, and good communication abilities. About You Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in systems and infrastructure administration, including demonstrated experience in a multi-site or hybrid environment. Proficiency in Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, ADSync or Microsoft Entra Connect, Microsoft Intune, and Windows Autopilot. Hands-on experience integrating Linux systems into a Windows Server domain and administering production Linux environments. Experience in server virtualization, resilient storage, backup, and disaster recovery. Education: University or college degree in computer science, computer engineering, cybersecurity, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Assets: Good command of IP networks, VLANs, VPNs, firewalls, QoS, and traffic management. (Knowledge and experience) Experience with Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) or a comparable storage platform. (Knowledge and experience) Language: The employee must be able to communicate effectively in French, both orally and in writing. Knowledge of English is an asset for collaborating with other scientists holding specific expertise, as well as with international partners. What We Offer Flexible schedules to support work/life balance A dynamic, close-knit, collaborative, and diverse international team for co-workers An impactful role in a growing scale-up that is leading in the Neutral Atom Quantum Computing space Competitive benefit packages Team outings Lots of time off to enjoy the things you love outside of work Free time to learn and attend conferences/meetups Employment Terms : Full‑time, permanent position Salary: $90,000 to $110,000 depending on experience and education Vacation: Starting at 4 weeks per year Recruitment process A 20-30 minute interview with our talent acquisition team via Teams Video meeting A 1 hour video interview with hiring manager via Teams Video meeting For technical roles: A technical Interview round via Teams Video with the hiring manager Final Interview An offer ! Pasqal is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, as inclusion and diversity are essential to achieving our mission. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, music preference, ethnicity, age, religion or sexual orientation. Joining Pasqal will give you the opportunity to take an active part in the rapid development of a DeepTech scale-up at the forefront of the second quantum revolution. You will be directly involved in one of the biggest challenges shaping the technological landscape of the 21st century. You will be working as part of a team of top-level scientists and engineers, in direct competition with the world's biggest players.

review_candidates.title: Linux Systems Engineer (Cybersecurity Technical Staff 2)
review_candidates.description: What You Will Do The Special Security Operations IT & Cyber Group (SSO-3) is seeking a skilled and motivated Linux systems engineer to join our Linux Services Team. This team designs, deploys, and maintains advanced Linux environments across multiple TS/SCI networks, supporting secure and mission-critical computing for national security programs. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the cybersecurity team to ensure compliance with all technical requirements. You will perform advanced systems administration of Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 servers and workstations, configuring, deploying, and maintaining compliant enterprise Linux systems. Providing mentoring and technical guidance to less experienced staff is also a key part of this position, as is offering operational support to customers using standard procedures. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Red Hat Enterprise Linux, automation tools, and version control systems and will play a key role in developing scalable, secure solutions that enable the Laboratory's scientific and national security missions. As a member of the Linux Services Team, your responsibilities will include: Support system patching and lifecycle management through Red Hat Satellite and local repositories Develop and maintain automation workflows using Ansible Automation Platform and GitLab Develop, document, and maintain baseline configurations and standard operating procedures Deploy and manage GPU-enabled systems (e.g., NVIDIA DGX, HGX, CUDA, containerized AI workloads) to support AI and data-intensive environments Support enterprise storage systems (NFS, NAS, NetApp) to ensure data availability and integrity Participate in requirements gathering, capacity planning, and infrastructure modernization efforts Work independently and in teams on diverse, challenging IT-related projects What You Need Minimum Job Requirements: Strong understanding of system security, access control, compliance frameworks, and risk management Extensive hands-on experience administering RHEL or similar Linux systems in enterprise environments Strong expertise with automation and configuration management tools (Ansible, Bash) Experience with GitLab or similar version control and CI/CD platforms Experience with Red Hat Satellite, configuration management, and patch automation Working knowledge of government hybrid cloud platforms such as OpenShift, AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, or DoD-accredited cloud environments Excellent communication and documentation skills Strong collaborative team and customer service mindset Education/Experience: Position requires a Bachelor's degree in a technical field and a minimum of 5 years' related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. At this level post graduate work may be expected. Desired Qualifications: Experience building systems to comply with NIST 800-53, CIS, DoD STIG standards Experience with GPU-based computing environments, including NVIDIA DGX and HGX systems, CUDA, and familiarity with containerized and orchestration technologies such as Podman and Kubernetes Experience managing Linux systems integrated with Microsoft Active Directory, including authentication Experience troubleshooting Linux network connectivity and performance issues Experience managing enterprise storage systems (NFS, NAS, SAN, NetApp, or equivalent) Active DOE Q or DoD TS/SCI clearance Training and Certifications: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) required or ability to obtain within 12 months Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) Work Environment: Work Location: The work location for this position is onsite and located in Los Alamos, NM. All work locations are at the discretion of management. Position commitment: Regular appointment employees are required to serve a period of continuous service in their current position in order to be eligible to apply for posted jobs throughout the Laboratory. If an employee has not served the time required, they may only apply for Laboratory jobs with the documented approval of their Division Leader. The position commitment for this position is 2 year. Note to Applicants: Due to federal restrictions contained in the current National Defense Authorization Act, citizens of the People's Republic of China-including the special administrative regions of Hong Kong and Macau-as well as citizens of the Islamic Republic of Iran, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea), and the Russian Federation, who are not Lawful Permanent Residents ("green card" holders) are prohibited from accessing facilities that support the mission, functions, and operations of national security laboratories and nuclear weapons production facilities, which includes Los Alamos National Laboratory. Where You Will Work Located in beautiful northern New Mexico, Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL) is a multidisciplinary research institution engaged in strategic science on behalf of national security. Our generous benefits package includes: PPO or High Deductible medical insurance with the same large nationwide network Dental and vision insurance Free basic life and disability insurance Paid childbirth and parental leave Award-winning 401(k) (6% matching plus 3.5% annually) Learning opportunities and tuition assistance Flexible schedules and time off (PTO and holidays) Onsite gyms and wellness programs Extensive relocation packages (outside a 50 mile radius) Additional Details Directive 206.2 - Employment with Triad requires a favorable decision by NNSA indicating employee is suitable under NNSA Supplemental Directive 206.2. Please note that this requirement applies only to citizens of the United States. Foreign nationals are subject to a similar requirement under DOE Order 142.3A. Clearance: Q or Q/SCI (Position will be cleared to this level). Selected applicants will be subject to a background investigation conducted by or on behalf of the Federal Government, and must meet eligibility requirements* for access to classified matter. This position requires a Q clearance. and obtaining such clearance requires US Citizenship except in extremely rare circumstances. Dependent upon the position, additional authorization to access classified information may be required, which may or may not be available to dual citizens. Receipt of a Q clearance and additional access authorization ultimately is a decision of the Federal Government and not of Triad. Eligibility requirements: To obtain a clearance, an individual must be at least 18 years of age; U.S. citizenship is required except in very limited circumstances. See DOE Order 472.2 for additional information. New-Employment Drug Test: The Laboratory requires successful applicants to complete a new-employment drug test and maintains a substance abuse policy that includes random drug testing. Although New Mexico and other states have legalized the use of marijuana, use and possession of marijuana remain illegal under federal law. A positive drug test for marijuana will result in termination of employment, even if the use was pre-offer. Regular position : Term status Laboratory employees applying for regular-status positions are converted to regular status. Internal Applicants: Regular appointment employees who have served the required period of continuous service in their current position are eligible to apply for posted jobs throughout the Laboratory. If an employee has not served the required period of continuous service, they may only apply for Laboratory jobs with the documented approval of their Division Leader. Please refer to Policy P701 for applicant eligibility requirements. Equal Opportunity: Los Alamos National Laboratory is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse and inclusive workforce. All employment practices are based on qualification and merit, without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status or spousal affiliation, physical or mental disability, medical conditions, pregnancy, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, or citizenship within the limits imposed by federal laws and regulations. The Laboratory is also committed to making our workplace accessible to individuals with disabilities and will provide reasonable accommodations, upon request, for individuals to participate in the application and hiring process. To request such an accommodation, please send an email to applyhelp@lanl.gov or call 1-505-664-6947 option 3.

review_candidates.description: Where Ambition Meets Innovation Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals. Job Overview: We are seeking a full-time AVP, Edge Security Engineer to join the Network & Security Engineering team within LPL’s Technology Platform Automation & Cloud Engineering organization. This role is responsible for architecting, building, and supporting enterprise-level edge infrastructure and security controls. You will also develop and maintain technical designs, documentation, and architecture artifacts aligned with security and infrastructure standards. The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of security and operations experience in a fast-paced, 24/7 enterprise environment, along with the ability to independently drive projects. This role collaborates across engineering teams, business units, and partners to deliver scalable, secure solutions that protect LPL’s edge. This role reports to the VP II of Network & Security Engineering and plays a key role in shaping LPL’s edge security strategy and roadmap. Responsibilities: Architect, build, and support highly available, secure, and scalable edge infrastructure Partner with Enterprise and Security Architecture teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise security standards Perform continuous edge threat hunting and mitigation Define and implement edge security infrastructure standards to drive automation, scale, and consistency Improve availability, security, and observability while closing control gaps across edge environments Conduct research and proof-of-concepts (POCs) to evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-driven solutions Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering teams and business stakeholders to deliver secure, customer-focused solutions Participate in an on-call rotation supporting availability, security, and performance incidents What are we looking for? We’re looking for collaborative, client-focused professionals who thrive in fast-paced environments and deliver a world-class, customer-first experience. The ideal candidate is a strong problem-solver who drives innovation through continuous improvement and effective execution. Requirements: 4+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting enterprise edge infrastructure and security controls using CDN platforms such as Cloudflare, Fastly, Akamai, etc 4+ years’ hands-on experience with enterprise monitoring platforms (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana) 3+ years’ hands-on experience with global load balancing (GLB) solutions (e.g., NS1, AWS Route 53, UltraDNS, Cloudflare Load Balancing) 2+ years’ hands-on experience managing enterprise DNS solutions (e.g., Infoblox, BIND) 2+ years’ experience building infrastructure automation using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Python, or Go 4+ years’ experience collaborating with development teams and project/program managers to architect and deliver infrastructure solutions Preferences: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field Hands-on experience implementing and maintaining secure web proxy solutions (e.g., Netskope, Zscaler) Experience managing cloud-delivered security services (e.g., Cisco Umbrella) Hands-on experience designing and implementing Network Detection and Response (NDR) solutions (e.g., ExtraHop, Vectra, Corelight, Darktrace) Relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CCNP Security, PCNSE, NSE) Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, and Microsoft 365 Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences Hands-on experience building and supporting enterprise load balancing platforms (e.g., F5 LTM, Citrix NetScaler, Avi/NSX ALB) Pay Range: $122,570.00 - $204,249.00 Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer! Company Overview: LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor-mediated marketplace(6) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE.
